venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Sunday 7/5 (MOD/Chef: KK, MD, JMS).** Net sales $1,033 vs a $2,153 target (−52%); food $77; comps $18.50 / 1.79%; 39 guests at a $27 check average. Pretty slow night — the crew figured Nashville was hungover after the holiday — but a few cocktail heads came in, several already familiar with Death & Co, plus some folks from Barcelona Wine Bar who got into the IYKYK shots and seem likely to return. Smooth night in the kitchen; no maintenance or incidents. Favorite moment: making cocktails for two young women visiting from Madison WI, one a cocktail bartender who could speak to what she was tasting.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Sunday 7/5 (AM: Maggie H; PM: Carey).** Total net sales $8,598.45 vs an $8,422.45 target (+2%); 151 guests (Tock) at a $56.94 check average; comps $269.90 / 3.14%. Splits: DC/AM $1,276.49, D&C PM $7,321.96, Garden/6A $1,254.54; food $2,356.20; no events. Busy morning pop with Kodi that turned into a nice cocktail pop after 2pm, with time on the back half to work on milk steaming and latte art. Very sleepy PM with no pop like the night before, which let the team make early cuts and lavish attention on the few guests in — lots of homies through. Super chill Garden day; chill kitchen night with a few pops (shoutout Dante and Rachel). A slow but productive start to the week. No incidents.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **DCLA — Sunday 7/5 (MOD: Joe; Chefs: Josh, Saleh).** Net sales $3,967 vs a $4,953 target (−20%); food $717; comps $137; 117 guests at an $84.41 check average; standing room closed. A chill Sunday after a long holiday weekend of partying and World Cup games. Started with 38 covers and a strange number of no-shows; the Arts District was packed ahead of the Mexico game (pushed back an hour), making the first couple of hours super sleepy — used for cleaning and getting ahead on prep. After the game the room filled by ~9:30pm; a small waitlist cleared fast and the room stayed full to last call for a smooth close. No issues with guests despite the crowds outside. Favorite moment: nerding out with member Carlos Martinez.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.narrative: **MG — Sunday 7/5 (AM: Justin/Lex; PM: Braden/Marcus).** Total net sales $5,291 vs a $16,500 target (−68%); food $2,009; comps $257; ~136 Municipal Bar covers (76 AM / 60 PM, OpenTable) at a $38.90 average. Splits: Municipal Bar morning $1,833 / evening $2,180, Sun Club $1,036, Hot Eye $1,184. Slow morning off the holiday weekend; very slow evening (Braden's slowest here) but good time for small projects — trays cleaned, glassware handled well, F&F visits. Sun Club had a decent day, closing early ~3:30pm for lightning. Typical Sunday at Hot Eye: early industry pop ~8:30pm, the regular 9pm bar crawl, a full room to ~10pm, then a lull and a late industry pop for a regular's birthday; usual Sunday back-bar and bottle scrub. Kitchen low on lemons (arriving AM); pushing roasted oysters and tuna crudo to avoid waste. No incidents; pest control requested for Hot Eye.
